LifeLoom Privacy Policy

Last updated: 29 August 2026

1. About this policy

This policy explains how LifeLoom handles information when you visit lifeloom.co.uk or contact LifeLoom for general support.

2. Information we may receive

The public website is designed to work without requiring an account. If you contact LifeLoom, we may receive the information you choose to send, such as your name, email address and the contents of your message.

3. Hosting and technical data

The website is hosted using Firebase Hosting. Hosting and security infrastructure may process limited technical information such as IP addresses, request details and diagnostic data needed to deliver and protect the service.

4. Analytics and cookies

The initial website does not intentionally set advertising cookies or include third-party advertising. If optional analytics are introduced later, this policy will be updated and any required consent controls will be added.

5. How information is used

Information sent to LifeLoom may be used to answer enquiries, provide support, maintain security and improve LifeLoom products and services.

6. Retention

Information is retained only for as long as reasonably needed for the purpose for which it was received, subject to legal or security requirements.

7. Your rights

Depending on applicable law, you may have rights relating to your personal information, including access, correction, deletion or restriction of certain processing.

8. App-specific policies

LifeLoom apps may process different information. Each app can have its own privacy policy describing its data practices.

9. Contact

For privacy questions, contact LifeLoom support.
